tests.name: Shape preservation
tests.code:
import torch
x = torch.randn(2, 3, 4)
assert {fn}(x).shape == x.shape, 'Shape mismatch'

tests.name: Gradient flow
tests.code:
import torch
x = torch.randn(4, 8, requires_grad=True)
{fn}(x).sum().backward()
assert x.grad is not None and x.grad.shape == x.shape, 'Gradient issue'
